messages:
Maria (Sales): Heads up — we're rolling a small rate‑card update next week (v3.4). Adds a region surcharge for APAC and new commit tiers. Planning to flip on Mon 09:00 PT. Please read: https://internal.redwood/ratecard/v3.4 :wave:

Ajay (Deal Desk): Do we have a cutover / grandfathering policy for existing committed deals? Any retroactive sku mapping?

Maria (Sales): Short answer: most existing committed SKUs map 1:1, but customers on the old 'Committed-Plus' plan need manual mapping. We'll publish a migration table. No retroactive price increases for signed commits.

Lenka (Solutions): For POCs — are we changing the free trial / eval discount? One of my POC customers is mid-market and may need a temporary surcharge waiver.

Maria (Sales): POC discounts unchanged. The APAC surcharge applies to usage billing only; we can approve waivers case-by-case. Flag here with account + ARR and I'll route to Ajay.

Ajay (Deal Desk): Cool. For waivers, we need an approval ticket with: account name, ARR, current commit SKU, requested effective window. Use this template: ```Account: Acme Co
ARR: $xx
Current SKU: committed-v2
Requested change: APAC surcharge waiver till 2026-06-30```

Samir (Legal): Quick legal note — any special pricing or manual credits must be documented in the SOW and reflected in billing terms. If you're granting a waiver longer than 90 days, loop Legal for T&Cs.

Lenka (Solutions): Thanks — adding that to my checklist. One more Q: does v3.4 change the commit breakage penalties?

Maria (Sales): No changes to breakage clauses. Commit tiers were restructured (see table) to add a small mid-tier that reduces per-token price at 100k->200k qps equivalent. It's mostly to encourage predictable commits.

RateBot: Automated note — v3.4 rollout plan published: https://internal.redwood/ratecard/deploys/v3.4 changelog. Staged rollout to hosted first, then Dedicated. Canary window: Mon 09:00–12:00 PT.

Ajay (Deal Desk): When will the migration table be available? I need it for quoting later this week.

Maria (Sales): I'll drop the migration table by EOD today. If anyone has urgent quoting needs, DM me the account and I'll prioritize. :thumbsup:

Samir (Legal): Also tagging @Ajay — if you expect more than three manual waivers for a single customer, Legal prefers a short memo summarizing commercial rationale.

Lenka (Solutions): Adding Acme Co to the thread — they asked about APAC surcharge exemptions. I'll post the account details to Ajay's ticket after the migration table is up.

Maria (Sales): Thanks team. Action items: (1) I publish migration table today. (2) Ajay: collect waiver tickets using template. (3) Samir: Legal review for >90d waivers. Ping me if blocker.

Ajay (Deal Desk): Acknowledged.

RateBot: Reminder scheduled: #sales notify at 2026-03-23T09:00:00Z about v3.4 canary status.
